meta.baseline_note: BL = rata-rata harian 06 Sep–30 Sep 2026 (25 hari) × 10 hari (pro-rata MTD)

key_issues: September CCM surged (+45%), driven by the inclusion of Virtual Assistant (Veronika) tickets in OKR calculation, accounting for 30% of total tickets.
Target adjustment is needed, as the current baseline excludes VA tickets.
Key issues: Makassar FO cut (12–13 Sep), Halmahera SKKL disruption (19–28 Sep), and prolonged rolling blackouts across 5/7 NOPs.
kabupaten_notes: Makassar had the largest reduction (-16), but remained the top CCM contributor.
Ticket spikes: 12 Sep (Makassar backbone FO cut) and 21–26 Sep (Halmahera Selatan SKKL issue).
Power issues remained a major contributor following rolling blackouts across 5/7 NOPs, with incomplete recovery.
increment Sep'26: KOTA MAKASSAR | FO cut | CCM tickets in Kota Makassar increased on 12–13 September, mainly contributed by sites in Biringkanaya and Tamalanrea districts, following a backbone FO cut.

HALMAHERA SELATAN | FO cut SKKL | Complaints in Halmahera Selatan increased by +21 tickets (+150%), aligned with the SKKL FO cut on ME-D7-LBH (Eth-Trunk25) – SME-D7-OBI and ME-D7-LBH (Eth-Trunk23) – SME2-D7-OBI. Update 28 Sep 2026: issue resolved after 9d 16h 14m 59s downtime.
